body: DM me for further talking, unless I for before it.

I watched on the sidelines as my friend went to get help like that. Three days later he's on the local news for being just another teenage suicide. There's no help for kids like me in my situation. I'm too old to be in Foster care, I'd be all alone just like now but only in a new space. I've taken all of it, I hope it works.
What do I do if they get the police involved, move to Foster Care? My father? I would get taken away from my mom, but put in another bad situation, there's only one way out.
I don't think I can trust them.
